  end

          end
        end
      end

main = do
    [n, k] <- map read . words <$> getLine :: IO [Integer]
    pos <- replicateM (fromIntegral n) ((\[a,b]->(a,b)) . map read . words <$> getLine) :: IO [(Integer, Integer)]
    ns <- concat <$> mapM (innerPoints pos k) [(p, p',p'')| p<-pos, p'<-pos, p''<-pos]

innerPoints :: [(Integer, Integer)] 
            -> Integer
            -> ((Integer,Integer), (Integer,Integer), (Integer,Integer))
            -> IO [Integer]
innerPoints pos k ((x,y), (x', y'),(x'', y'')) = let
    isInner (x''', y''') =  minimum [x,x',x''] <= x''' && x''' <= maximum [x,x',x'']
                         && minimum [y,y',y''] <= y''' && y''' <= maximum [y,y',y'']
    innerP = sum . map (\b->if b then 1 else 0) $ map isInner pos
    in return [(maximum [x,x',x'']-minimum [x,x',x'']) * (maximum [y,y',y''] - minimum [y,y',y'']) | innerP >= k]

sol :: V.Vector (V.Vector Integer) -> Integer
sol v = minimum [g l r d u | 
  l <- [0..n-2], r <- [l+1..n-1], d <- [0..n-2], u <- [d+1..n-1], k <= f l r d u]
  where
  [n,k] = fmap fromIntegral $ V.toList (v!0) :: [Int]
  ps = V.tail v
  xs = V.modify A.sort $ V.map V.head ps
  ys = V.modify A.sort $ V.map V.last ps
  f l r d u = V.length $ V.filter (\p -> inRange (xs!l,xs!r) (p!0) && inRange (ys!d,ys!u) (p!1)) ps
  g l r d u = (xs!r - xs!l)*(ys!u - ys!d)

solve :: Int -> Int -> U.Vector (Int, Int) -> Int
solve n k ps = minimum $ do
    i <- [0..n-1]
    i' <- [i+1..n-1]
    j <- [0..n-1]
    j' <- [j+1..n-1]
    let !minX = U.unsafeIndex xs i
        !maxX = U.unsafeIndex xs i'
        !minY = U.unsafeIndex ys j
        !maxY = U.unsafeIndex ys j'
    let inRect (x, y) = minX <= x && x <= maxX && minY <= y && y <= maxY
    guard $ (k<=) . U.length $ U.filter inRect ps
    return $! (maxX - minX) * (maxY - minY)
  where
    !xs = U.modify Intro.sort $ U.map fst ps
    !ys = U.modify Intro.sort $ U.map snd ps

rep :: (Monad m) => Int -> (Int -> m ()) -> m ()
rep n = flip MS.mapM_ (stream 0 n)
{-# INLINE rep #-}
rev :: (Monad m) => Int -> (Int -> m ()) -> m ()
rev !n = flip MS.mapM_ (streamR 0 n)
{-# INLINE rev #-}
stream :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
stream !l !r = MS.Stream step l where { step x | x < r = return $ MS.Yield x (x + 1) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] stream #-}
streamR :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
streamR !l !r = MS.Stream step (r - 1) where { step x | x >= l = return $ MS.Yield x (x - 1) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] streamR #-}
stream' :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
stream' !l !r !d = MS.Stream step l where { step x | x < r = return $ MS.Yield x (x + d) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] stream' #-}

solve :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector (Int, Int) -> Int
solve !n !k !xys =
  minimum
    $ [ area x12 y12
      | x12 <- xcandidates
      , y12 <- ycandidates
      , countInside x12 y12 >= k
      ]
 where
  xcandidates =
    let xs = VU.fromList $ sort $ VU.toList $ VU.map fst xys
    in  [ (xs VU.! x1, xs VU.! x2)
        | x1 <- [0 .. n - 2]
        , x2 <- [x1 + 1 .. n - 1]
        ]
  ycandidates =
    let ys = VU.fromList $ sort $ VU.toList $ VU.map snd xys
    in  [ (ys VU.! y1, ys VU.! y2)
        | y1 <- [0 .. n - 2]
        , y2 <- [y1 + 1 .. n - 1]
        ]

  countInside (x1, x2) (y1, y2) = VU.length
    $ VU.filter (\(x, y) -> x1 <= x && x <= x2 && y1 <= y && y <= y2) xys

  area (x1, x2) (y1, y2) = (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1)

import Data.List

type Point = (Integer, Integer)

windows :: Integer -> [a] -> [[a]]
windows k xs
    | length xs < fromIntegral k = []
    | otherwise = (take (fromIntegral k) xs) : windows k (tail xs)

minArea :: [Point] -> Integer -> (Integer, Integer) -> Integer
minArea points k (x1, x2) =
    let insidePoints = filter (\(x, _) -> x1 <= x && x <= x2) points
        sortedPoints = sortBy (\(_, y1) (_, y2) -> compare y1 y2) insidePoints
        groups = windows k sortedPoints
    in if null groups
       then 40000000000000000000
       else minimum $ map area groups
    where area ps = xDist * (yDist ps)
          xDist = x2 - x1
          yDist ps = (snd $ last ps) - (snd $ head ps)

solve :: [Point] -> Integer -> Integer
solve points k =
    let xs = sort $ map fst points
        pairs = [(x1, x2) | x1 <- xs, x2 <- xs, x1 < x2]
    in minimum $ map (minArea points k) pairs

innerPoints :: [(Integer, Integer)]

innerPoints pos k ((x,y), (x', y'),(x'', y'')) = let

                         && minimum [y,y',y''] <= y''' && y''' <= maximum [y,y',y'']

  "Returns the cumulative sum of the region given by the rectangle [i0, i1)*[j0,

(defun main ()
  (declare #.OPT)
  (let* ((n (read))
         (k (read))
         (xs (make-array n :element-type 'int32))
         (ys (make-array n :element-type 'int32))
         (ord-xs (make-array n :element-type 'uint8))
         (ord-ys (make-array n :element-type 'uint8))
         (cumul (make-array (list (+ n 1) (+ n 1)) :element-type 'uint8 :initial-element 0))
         (res most-positive-fixnum))
    (declare (uint8 n k) (uint62 res))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (setf (aref xs i) (read))
      (setf (aref ys i) (read))
      (setf (aref ord-xs i) i)
      (setf (aref ord-ys i) i))
    (setf ord-xs (sort ord-xs (lambda (i j) (< (aref xs i) (aref xs j)))))
    (setf ord-ys (sort ord-ys (lambda (i j) (< (aref ys i) (aref ys j)))))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((ord-x (the uint8 (position i ord-xs)))
            (ord-y (position i ord-ys)))
        (incf (aref cumul (+ ord-y 1) (+ ord-x 1)))))
    (dotimes (y (+ n 1))
      (dotimes (x n)
        (incf (aref cumul y (+ x 1)) (aref cumul y x))))
    (dotimes (x (+ n 1))
      (dotimes (y n)
        (incf (aref cumul (+ y 1) x)  (aref cumul y x))))
    (dotimes (y1-ord n)
      (dotimes (x1-ord n)
        (loop for y2-ord from (+ 1 y1-ord) below n
              do (loop for x2-ord from (+ 1 x1-ord) below n

                                (y2 (aref ys (aref ord-ys y2-ord)))
                                (x2 (aref xs (aref ord-xs x2-ord))))
                            (setf res (min res (the fixnum (* (- y2 y1) (- x2 x1))))))))))

  x = [nil] * n

        end
      end
    end
  end

def solve(xt_o,yt_o,pt,n,k)
  xt = xt_o.sort
  yt = yt_o.sort
  target = []
  ans = Float::INFINITY

  for x1 in 0..(n-1) do
    for x2 in (x1+1)..(n-1) do
      for y1 in 0..(n-1) do
        for y2 in (y1+1)..(n-1) do
          target << [xt[x1],yt[y1],xt[x2],yt[y2]]
        end
      end
    end
  end
#cumulative sum
  arr = Hash.new(0)
  for x in 0..(n-1) do
    for y in 0..(n-1) do
      cnt = 0
      for i in 0..(n-1) do
        judge = ((xt[0] <= xt_o[i]) && (xt_o[i] <= xt[x])) &&
                ((yt[0] <= yt_o[i]) && (yt_o[i] <= yt[y]))
        cnt = cnt + 1 if judge
      end
    arr[ [xt[x],yt[y]] ] = cnt
    end
  end
  target.each{|t|
  corner = pt[ [t[0],t[1]] ] + pt[ [t[0],t[3]] ] + pt[ [t[2],t[1]] ]
  cnt = arr[ [t[2],t[3]] ] - arr[ [t[0],t[3]] ] - arr[ [t[2],t[1]] ] + arr[ [t[0],t[1]] ] + corner
  if k <= cnt then
    area = (t[2] - t[0]).abs * (t[3] - t[1]).abs
    ans = [ans,area].min
  end
}
ans
end

def solve(xt_o,yt_o,n,k)
  xt = xt_o.sort
  yt = yt_o.sort
  target = []
  for x1 in 0..(n-1) do
    for x2 in (x1+1)..(n-1) do
      for y1 in 0..(n-1) do
        for y2 in (y1+1)..(n-1) do
          area = (xt[x2] - xt[x1]).abs * (yt[y2] - yt[y1]).abs
          target << [area,xt[x1],xt[x2],yt[y1],yt[y2]]
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # max area
  ans = (xt[n-1] - xt[0]).abs * (yt[n-1] - yt[0]).abs

  target.each{|t|
    cnt = 0
    for i in 0..(n-1) do
      judge = ((t[1] <= xt_o[i]) && (xt_o[i] <= t[2])) && ((t[3] <= yt_o[i]) && (yt_o[i] <= t[4]))
      cnt = cnt + 1 if judge
    end
    if k <= cnt then
      ans = [ans,t[0]].min
    end
  }
  ans
end

def solve(xt_o,yt_o,n,k)
  xt = xt_o.sort
  yt = yt_o.sort
  target = []
  for x1 in 0..(n-1) do
    for x2 in (x1+1)..(n-1) do
      for y1 in 0..(n-1) do
        for y2 in (y1+1)..(n-1) do
          area = (xt[x2] - xt[x1]).abs * (yt[y2] - yt[y1]).abs
          target << [area,xt[x1],xt[x2],yt[y1],yt[y2]]
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # max area
  ans = (xt[n-1] - xt[0]).abs * (yt[n-1] - yt[0]).abs

  target.each{|t|
    cnt = 0
    for i in 0..(n-1) do
      judge = ((t[1] <= xt_o[i]) && (xt_o[i] <= t[2])) && ((t[3] <= yt_o[i]) && (yt_o[i] <= t[4]))
      cnt = cnt + 1 if judge
    end
    if k <= cnt then
      ans = [ans,t[0]].min
    end
  }
  ans
end

    @n,@k = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
    @x,@y = Array.new(n){ gets.split.map(&:to_i) }.transpose
  end

  def solve
    ans = 2**62
    n.times do |ox|
      n.times do |dx|
        next unless x[ox] < x[dx]
        n.times do |oy|
          n.times do |dy|
            next unless y[oy] < y[dy]
            if k <= n.times.count do |i|
              x[ox] <= x[i] &&
              x[i] <= x[dx] &&
              y[oy] <= y[i] &&
              y[i] <= y[dy]
            end
              area = (x[ox]-x[dx]).abs*(y[oy]-y[dy]).abs
              ans = area if area < ans
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    ans
  end

  def show(ans)
    puts ans
  end
end

def count_dots x_range, y_range
  x_range.sort!
  s_idx = @ary.index{|dot| dot[0] == x_range[0]}
  e_idx = @ary.rindex{|dot| dot[0] == x_range[1]}
  y_range.sort!
  @ary[s_idx..e_idx].count do |dot|
    y_range[0] <= dot[1]  && dot[1] <= y_range[1]
  end
end

def main(argv)
  (n, k) = gets.chomp.split(' ').map(&:to_i)

  p = [nil] * n
  x = [nil] * n
  y = [nil] * n
  n.times do |i|
    (x[i], y[i]) = gets.chomp.split(' ').map(&:to_i)
    p[i] = {:x => x[i], :y => y[i]}
  end
  x.sort!
  y.sort!
  
  s_min = 1e+20.to_i
  n.times do |ix|
    x_min = x[ix]
    
    n.times do |iy|
      y_min = y[iy]
      
      (ix+1...n).each do |jx|
        x_max = x[jx]
        
        (iy+1...n).each do |jy|
          y_max = y[jy]
          
          c = 0
          n.times do |l|
            if x_min <= p[l][:x] && p[l][:x] <= x_max then
              if y_min <= p[l][:y] && p[l][:y] <= y_max then
                c += 1
              end
            end
          end
          
          if c >= k then
            s_min = [s_min, (x_max - x_min) * (y_max - y_min)].min
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  
  puts s_min.to_s
end

if self.to_s == 'main' then

(* n: int ref *)
let n = ref 0

(* k: int ref *)
let k = ref 0

(* pos: (int * int) list ref *)
let pos = ref []

(* sort_x: ('a * 'a) list -> ('a * 'a) list *)
let sort_x lst =
  List.sort (fun (x1, _) (x2, _) -> if x1 < x2 then -1 else 1) lst

(* sort_y: ('a * 'a) list -> ('a * 'a) list *)
let sort_y lst =
  List.sort (fun (_, y1) (_, y2) -> if y1 < y2 then -1 else 1) lst

(* minimum: 'a list -> 'a *)
let minimum lst =
  List.fold_left min max_int lst

(* soi: int -> string *)
let soi = string_of_int
(* pr: int -> unit *)
let pr x = print_endline (soi x)

(* calc_area: (int * int) list -> int *)
let calc_area lst = match lst with
  | [] -> 0
  | _ ->
    (* let _ = if List.length lst <> !k then failwith "err" in *)
    let h (x1, x2, y1, y2) (x, y) =
      (min x1 x, max x2 x, min y1 y, max y2 y)
    in
    let (x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max) =
      List.fold_left h (max_int, min_int, max_int, min_int) lst
    in
    (x_max - x_min) * (y_max - y_min)

(* heads: int -> 'a list -> 'a list *)
let rec heads len l = match l with
  | _ when len = 0 -> []
  | [] -> raise Not_found
  | x :: xs -> x :: (heads (len - 1) xs)

(* get_k_areas: ('a * 'a) list -> int list *)
let rec get_k_areas lst = match lst with
  | [] -> []
  | _ :: xs ->
    if List.length lst < !k then
      []
    else
      let l = heads !k lst in
      (calc_area l) :: (get_k_areas xs)

(* get_areas_on_x: unit -> int list *)
let get_areas_on_x () =
  !pos
  |> sort_x
  |> get_k_areas

(* get_areas_on_y: unit -> int list *)
let get_areas_on_y () =
  !pos
  |> sort_y
  |> get_k_areas

(* main: unit -> int *)
let main () =
  let sq_lst1 = get_areas_on_x () in
  let min1 = minimum sq_lst1 in
  let sq_lst2 = get_areas_on_y () in
  let min2 = minimum sq_lst2 in
  min min1 min2

(* subst: int -> int -> (int * int) list -> unit *)
let subst n_ k_ lst =
  n := n_;
  k := k_;
  pos := lst

(* start: int -> int -> (int * int) list -> unit *)
let start n_ k_ lst =
  subst n_ k_ lst;
  main ()
  |> string_of_int
  |> print_endline

proc createUncompressor(): auto =
  let
    sortedX = (0..<N).mapIt((points[it].x, points[it].y, it)).sorted(proc (a, b: tuple[x, y, i: int]): int = cmp(a.x, b.x))
    sortedY = (0..<N).mapIt((points[it].x, points[it].y, it)).sorted(proc (a, b: tuple[x, y, i: int]): int = cmp(a.y, b.y))
  result = proc (n: int; s: string): int =
    if s == "x": sortedX[n][2]
    else       : sortedY[n][2]



let ucps = createUncompressor()

proc bt(l, r: int): tuple[bottom, top: int] =
  var minmax: tuple[min, max: int] = (points[l].y, points[l].y)
  result = (l, l)
  for i in l..r:
    let
      yi = ucps(i, "x")
      y = points[yi].y
    if minmax.min > y:
      minmax.min = y
      result.bottom = yi
    if minmax.max < y:
      minmax.max = y
      result.top = yi

    outsides_top = []

        # n_inside = N - t

        outsides_bottom = []
        b = 0
        while b < N:
            # n_inside -= b

                break

            # outsides_left = []

            l = 0
            while l < N:
                left_i, left_x, left_y = points_xsort[l]

                if left_x > top_x:

                    if right_i == left_i:

                l += 1
            
            outsides_bottom.append(bottom_i)
            b += 1
        
        outsides_top.append(top_i)
        t += 1

    return min_area

def D_Axis_Parallel_Rectangle(N, K, P):
    x = [0 for _ in range(N)]  # 点のx座標
    y = [0 for _ in range(N)]  # y座標
    x_array = [0 for _ in range(N)]
    y_array = [0 for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        x[i] = P[i][0]
        y[i] = P[i][1]
        x_array[i] = x[i]
        y_array[i] = y[i]

    x_array = sorted(x_array)
    y_array = sorted(y_array)

    # すべての点を内部に含む、最大の面積を持つ矩形が初期値
    ans = (x_array[N - 1] - x_array[0]) * (y_array[N - 1] - y_array[0])

    # 全探索
    for xi in range(0, N, 1):
        for xj in range(xi + 1, N, 1):
            for yi in range(0, N, 1):
                for yj in range(yi + 1, N, 1):
                    num = 0
                    left = x_array[xi]
                    right = x_array[xj]
                    bottom = y_array[yi]
                    upper = y_array[yj]

                    for i in range(N):
                        if(left <= x[i] and x[i] <= right and bottom <= y[i] and y[i] <= upper):
                            num += 1
                    if num >= K:
                        ans = min(ans, (right - left) * (upper - bottom))
    return ans

import sys
from sys import stdin
from statistics import mean
from math import sqrt
input = stdin.readline


def solve(points, N, K):
    to_remove = N - K

    while to_remove:
        sx = [p[0] for p in points]
        sy = [p[1] for p in points]
        cx = mean(sx)
        cy = mean(sy)

        dist = [0] * len(points)
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            dist[i] = sqrt((cx - p[0])**2 + (cy - p[1])**2)

        i = dist.index(max(dist))
        points.pop(i)
        to_remove -= 1

    points.sort()
    lx = points[0][0]
    rx = points[-1][0]
    points.sort(key=lambda p: p[1])
    by = points[0][1]
    uy = points[-1][1]

    return (rx - lx) * (uy - by)



def main(args):
    N, K = map(int, input().split())
    points = []
    for _ in range(N):
        points.append([int(x) for x in input().split()])

    result = solve(points, N, K)
    print(result)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1:])

def resolve():

    xy = [LI() for _ in range(N)]

    # x, y全ての重複あり組み合わせに対して含まれる点の個数を算出する

    max_x = ar[:,0].max()
    min_x = ar[:,0].min()
    max_y = ar[:,1].max()
    min_y = ar[:,1].min()
    return (max_x-min_x)*(max_y-min_y)

        tmp_k_ar = k_ar.copy()

def solve(points, N, K):
    x_points = points[:]
    x_points.sort()
    y_points = points[:]
    y_points.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])

    ans = (x_points[-1][0] - x_points[0][0]) * (y_points[-1][1] - y_points[0][1])
    for xi in range(N):
        for xj in range(xi+1, N):
            for yi in range(N):
                for yj in range(yi+1, N):
                    num = 0
                    lx = x_points[xi][0]
                    rx = x_points[xj][0]
                    by = y_points[yi][1]
                    uy = y_points[yj][1]

                    for i in range(N):
                        if lx <= x_points[i][0] <= rx and by <= y_points[i][1] <= uy:
                            num += 1
                    if num >= K:
                        ans = min(ans, (rx - lx) * (uy - by))
    return ans

def axis_parallel_rectangle(N: int, K: int, xy: list)->int:
    # 1. 座標圧縮
    XY = sorted(xy)

    min_area = float('inf')
    for xli in range(N-K+1):
        xri = xli + K - 1
        ymin, ymax = float('inf'), -float('inf')
        for _, y in XY[xli:xri+1]:
            ymin = min(ymin, y)
            ymax = max(ymax, y)

        xmin, xmax = XY[xli][0], XY[xri][0]
        min_area = min(min_area, (xmax-xmin)*(ymax-ymin))

    return min_area

def solve(points, N, K):
    x_arr = [p[0] for p in points]
    y_arr = [p[1] for p in points]
    x_arr.sort()
    y_arr.sort()

    ans = (x_arr[-1] - x_arr[0]) * (y_arr[-1] - y_arr[0])
    for xi in range(N):
        for xj in range(xi+1, N):
            for yi in range(N):
                for yj in range(yi+1, N):

    class TwoDimTree:
        def __init__(self, points=[]):

            root の深さを 0 として、深さが偶数の場合そこでは x を基準に、奇数の場合 y を基準に二分探索木条件を満たすようにする
            '''
            # nil の設定

            self.nil.parent = self.nil
            self.nil.left = self.nil
            self.nil.right = self.nil
            # root の設定

        def _balance_insert(self, seq, depth=0):
            # 毎回 x or y をキーとしてソートを行い、中央値をとって insert すれば平衡になる
            if seq:
                arranged = sorted(seq, key=itemgetter(depth % 2))
                mid = len(seq) // 2
                self.insert(arranged[mid][0], arranged[mid][1])
                self._balance_insert(arranged[:mid], depth+1)
                self._balance_insert(arranged[mid+1:], depth+1)
    
    
        def insert(self, x, y):
            '''
            kD tree に値が (x, y) であるノードを O(depth) で挿入する
            (コンストラクタで生成した kD tree は平衡であることが保証されるが、insert により生成した部分の平衡性は保証されないことに注意)        
            '''
            trailer = self.nil    # (x, y) を挿入するべき nil の一つ前のノードを保存するトレーラポインタ
            pos = self.root    # (x, y) を挿入するべき nil の場所を探す
            depth = 0
            while pos != self.nil:
                trailer = pos
                k, pos_k = (x, pos.x) if depth % 2 == 0 else (y, pos.y)
                if k < pos_k:
                    pos = pos.left
                elif pos_k < k:
                    pos = pos.right
                else:
                    pos.flag ^= pos.flag
                    pos = pos.left if pos.flag else pos.right
                depth += 1
            inserted_node = TwoDimNode(x, y, trailer, self.nil, self.nil)
            # trailer の depth
            depth -= 1
            k, trailer_k = (x, trailer.x) if depth % 2 == 0 else (y, trailer.y)
            # tree is empty
            if trailer == self.nil:
                self.root = inserted_node
            # どこかのノードの子供の位置に挿入する時
            elif k < trailer_k or (k == trailer_k and trailer.flag):
                trailer.left = inserted_node
            else:
                trailer.right = inserted_node
        
        def two_dim_search(self, sx, tx, sy, ty, node=None, depth=0):

            kD tree に対し閉区間 D = {(x, y) | sx<=x<=tx, sy<=y<=ty} 内に存在する点を探してリストにまとめて返す (対応する点の個数 k として O(√n + k))

                        <----->

            # else:

            #     if node.right != self.nil and ty >= node.y:
            #         buf += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.right, depth+1)
            # return buf
            cnt = 0
            node = self.root if node is None else node
            if depth % 2 == 0:
                if node.left != self.nil and sx <= node.x:
                    cnt += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.left, depth+1)
                if sx <= node.x <= tx and sy <= node.y <= ty:

def ok(y1, y2, x1, x2, yd, yd2, xd, xd2, K):
    if (y1, y2) in memo1:
        y = memo1[(y1, y2)]
    else:
        a = yd2[y1]
        b = yd[y2]
        y = b.difference(a)
        memo1[(y1, y2)] = y

    if (x1, x2) in memo2:
        x = memo2[(x1, x2)]
    else:
        c = xd2[x1]

        x = d.difference(c)
        memo2[(x1, x2)] = x

    n = len(y & x)

    ps = []
    for _ in range(n):
        px, py = map(int, input().split())

    min_area = float('inf')
    for i in range(n-k+1):

    left = 10**10
    right = -(10**10)
    upper = -(10**10)
    lower = 10**10

    for p in P:
        left = min(p[0], left)
        right = max(p[0], right)

def f(N, K, x, y):
    """
    制約
    * 2≦K≦N≦50
    * −10^9≦xi,yi≦10^9 (1≦i≦N)
    * xi≠xj (1≦i<j≦N)
    * yi≠yj (1≦i<j≦N)
    * 入力値はすべて整数である。(21:50 追記)

    長方形の内部にN点のうち
    K個以上の点を含みつつ、
    それぞれの辺がX軸かY軸に平行な長方形を考えます。
    →最小の面積

    制約より、
    xyの範囲を全探索はTLE
    点は重ならないかつ、50以下
    →点の座標から求めれば間に合いそう

    例題1より、
    全ての点を含む場合、
    abs(x_max-x_min) * abs(y_max-y_min)
    => 追記:
        これを分かったのに図示しなかったため、
        点が角ではなく辺上にのることに気づかず…
        点同士の組合せになってしまった(座標同士の組合せと気づけたはず)

    例題2より
    １つの場合1、ただし1*1の長方形より最大4点含む
    →この例の場合、4点から2点以上で面積1

    (x_2nd-x_min)*(y_max-y_min)
    →x_maxを除いた点が含まれる
    →50*50では済まない

    y
    ↑
    |*...
    |.*..
    |...*
    |*...
    ------→x
    (0,0)
    (0,4)
    (1,3)
    (3,1)

    各点を結んだときの面積の個数：O(N*N)
    面積求めたあとの点が含まれる個数の計算量: O(N)
    => O(N^3) => 50^3 => 1.25 * 10^5 => OK
      点を必ず含む場所からの面積
      => そこからでなくてよい, むしろ広くなる

    => 
    """
    ans = abs(max(x) - min(x)) * abs(max(y) - min(y))
    if K == N:
        print(ans)
        return

    def r(x, y):
        for _x in x:
            for _y in y:
                yield _x, _y

    # for x1, y1 in zip(x, y):
    #     for x2, y2 in zip(x, y):
    for x1, y1 in r(x, y):
        for x2, y2 in r(x, y):

            s = abs(x1-x2) * abs(y1-y2)
            if s == 0:
                continue

            min_x = min(x1, x2)
            max_x = max(x1, x2)
            min_y = min(y1, y2)
            max_y = max(y1, y2)

            contains_count = 0
            for x3, y3 in zip(x, y):
                if min_x <= x3 <= max_x and min_y <= y3 <= max_y:
                    contains_count += 1
            if contains_count >= K:
                ans = min(ans, s)

    print(ans)

        b = yd[y2]

    x = d.difference(c)
    # print(a, b, c, d)

    n = len(y & x)

    return n >= K

import sys
from itertools import accumulate
def input(): return sys.stdin.readline().strip()

def main():
    N, K = map(int, input().split())
    points = []
    X = set()
    Y = set()
    for _ in range(N):
        x, y = map(int, input().split())
        points.append((x, y))
        X.add(x)
        Y.add(y)
    X = list(X)
    Y = list(Y)
    X.sort()
    Y.sort()

    mapX = {} # mapX[x] = (点のx座標が小さい方から何番目か)
    mapY = {} # mapY[y] = (点のy座標が小さい方から何番目か)
    for i, x in enumerate(X): mapX[x] = i + 1
    for i, y in enumerate(Y): mapY[y] = i + 1

    # 圧縮後の座標平面に対してグリッドを張るので、そのサイズを求めておく
    h, w = len(mapX), len(mapY)
    grid = [[0] * (w + 1) for _ in range(h + 1)]
    for x, y in points:
        grid[mapY[y]][mapX[x]] = 1
    sum_grid = [list(accumulate(grid[y])) for y in range(h + 1)]
    for y in range(1, h + 1):
        for x in range(1, w + 1):
            sum_grid[y][x] += sum_grid[y - 1][x]
    print("sum_grid")
    for y in range(h + 1):
        print(sum_grid[y])

    ans = 10**20
    for sx in range(1, w + 1):
        for sy in range(1, h + 1):
            for ex in range(sx, w + 1):
                for ey in range(sy, h + 1):
                    cnt = sum_grid[ey][ex] - sum_grid[ey][sx-1] - sum_grid[sy-1][ex] + sum_grid[sy-1][sx-1]
                    if cnt < K: continue
                    area = (X[ex - 1] - X[sx - 1]) * (Y[ey - 1] - Y[sy - 1])
                    ans = min(ans, area)
    print(ans)

        #         self.preorder_traverse(node=node.right)
        
        def _balance_insert(self, seq, depth=0):
            # 毎回 x or y をキーとしてソートを行い、中央値をとって insert すれば平衡になる
            if seq:
                arranged = sorted(seq, key=itemgetter(depth % 2))
                mid = len(seq) // 2
                self.insert(arranged[mid][0], arranged[mid][1])
                self._balance_insert(arranged[:mid], depth+1)
                self._balance_insert(arranged[mid+1:], depth+1)
    
    
        def insert(self, x, y):
            '''
            kD tree に値が (x, y) であるノードを O(depth) で挿入する
            (コンストラクタで生成した kD tree は平衡であることが保証されるが、insert により生成した部分の平衡性は保証されないことに注意)        
            '''
            trailer = self.nil    # (x, y) を挿入するべき nil の一つ前のノードを保存するトレーラポインタ
            pos = self.root    # (x, y) を挿入するべき nil の場所を探す
            depth = 0
            while pos != self.nil:
                trailer = pos
                k, pos_k = (x, pos.x) if depth % 2 == 0 else (y, pos.y)
                if k < pos_k:
                    pos = pos.left
                elif pos_k < k:
                    pos = pos.right
                else:
                    pos.flag ^= pos.flag
                    pos = pos.left if pos.flag else pos.right
                depth += 1
            inserted_node = TwoDimNode(x, y, trailer, self.nil, self.nil)
            # trailer の depth
            depth -= 1
            k, trailer_k = (x, trailer.x) if depth % 2 == 0 else (y, trailer.y)
            # tree is empty
            if trailer == self.nil:
                self.root = inserted_node
            # どこかのノードの子供の位置に挿入する時
            elif k < trailer_k or (k == trailer_k and trailer.flag):
                trailer.left = inserted_node
            else:
                trailer.right = inserted_node
        
        def two_dim_search(self, sx, tx, sy, ty, node=None, depth=0):
            '''
            kD tree に対し閉区間 D = {(x, y) | sx<=x<=tx, sy<=y<=ty} 内に存在する点を探してリストにまとめて返す (対応する点の個数 k として O(√n + k))
            下記のように検索必要性を判断し再帰的に左右の子に対し探索を行えば良い
    
            <-------- node.x -------->
            <----------->
            少しでも [sx,tx] が左側ゾーン ((-inf, node.x]) に被っていたら検索しておく必要がある
                        <----->
                        少しでも [sx, tx] が右側ゾーン ([node.x, inf)) に被っていたら検索しておく必要がある
            '''        
            # buf = []
            # node = self.root if node is None else node
            # # print(f'{node.x} {node.y}')
            # if depth % 2 == 0:
            #     if node.left != self.nil and sx <= node.x:
            #         buf += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.left, depth+1)
            #     if sx <= node.x <= tx and sy <= node.y <= ty:
            #         buf.append((node.x, node.y))
            #     if node.right != self.nil and tx >= node.x:
            #         buf += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.right, depth+1)
            # else:
            #     if node.left != self.nil and sy <= node.y:
            #         buf += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.left, depth+1)
            #     if sx <= node.x <= tx and sy <= node.y <= ty:
            #         buf.append((node.x, node.y))
            #     if node.right != self.nil and ty >= node.y:
            #         buf += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.right, depth+1)
            # return buf
            cnt = 0
            node = self.root if node is None else node
            if depth % 2 == 0:
                if node.left != self.nil and sx <= node.x:
                    cnt += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.left, depth+1)
                if sx <= node.x <= tx and sy <= node.y <= ty:
                    cnt += 1
                if node.right != self.nil and tx >= node.x:
                    cnt += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.right, depth+1)
            else:
                if node.left != self.nil and sy <= node.y:
                    cnt += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.left, depth+1)
                if sx <= node.x <= tx and sy <= node.y <= ty:
                    cnt += 1
                if node.right != self.nil and ty >= node.y:
                    cnt += self.two_dim_search(sx, tx, sy, ty, node.right, depth+1)
            return cnt

def D_Axis_Parallel_Rectangle(N, K, P):
    x = [0 for _ in range(N)]  # 点のx座標
    y = [0 for _ in range(N)]  # y座標
    x_array = [0 for _ in range(N)]
    y_array = [0 for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        x[i] = P[i][0]
        y[i] = P[i][1]
        x_array[i] = x[i]
        y_array[i] = y[i]

    x_array = sorted(x_array)
    y_array = sorted(y_array)

    # すべての点を内部に含む、最大の面積を持つ矩形が初期値
    ans = (x_array[N - 1] - x_array[0]) * (y_array[N - 1] - y_array[0])

    # 全探索
    for xi in range(0, N, 1):
        for xj in range(xi + 1, N, 1):
            for yi in range(0, N, 1):
                for yj in range(yi + 1, N, 1):
                    num = 0
                    left = x_array[xi]
                    right = x_array[xj]
                    bottom = y_array[yi]
                    upper = y_array[yj]

                    for i in range(N):
                        if(left <= x[i] and x[i] <= right and bottom <= y[i] and y[i] <= upper):
                            num += 1
                    if num >= K:
                        ans = min(ans, (right - left) * (upper - bottom))
    return ans

    * 入力値はすべて整数である。(21:50 追記)

    長方形の内部にN点のうち
    K個以上の点を含みつつ、
    それぞれの辺がX軸かY軸に平行な長方形を考えます。
    →最小の面積

    制約より、
    xyの範囲を全探索はTLE
    点は重ならないかつ、50以下
    →点の座標から求めれば間に合いそう

    例題1より、
    全ての点を含む場合、
    abs(x_max-x_min) * abs(y_max-y_min)
    => 追記:
        これを分かったのに図示しなかったため、
        点が角ではなく辺上にのることに気づかず…
        点同士の組合せになってしまった(座標同士の組合せと気づけたはず)

    例題2より
    １つの場合1、ただし1*1の長方形より最大4点含む
    →この例の場合、4点から2点以上で面積1

    (x_2nd-x_min)*(y_max-y_min)
    →x_maxを除いた点が含まれる
    →50*50では済まない

    y
    ↑
    |*...
    |.*..
    |...*
    |*...
    ------→x
    (0,0)
    (0,4)
    (1,3)
    (3,1)

    各点を結んだときの面積の個数：O(N*N)
    面積求めたあとの点が含まれる個数の計算量: O(N)
    => O(N^3) => 50^3 => 1.25 * 10^5 => OK
      点を必ず含む場所からの面積
      => そこからでなくてよい, むしろ広くなる

    => 
    """
    ans = abs(max(x) - min(x)) * abs(max(y) - min(y))
    if K == N:
        print(ans)
        return

    def r(x, y, x_start=0, y_start=0):
        for xi in range(x_start, N):
            for yi in range(y_start, N):
                yield x[xi], y[yi], xi, yi

    # for x1, y1 in zip(x, y):

    x = sorted(x)
    y = sorted(y)
    for min_x, min_y, xi, yi in r(x, y):
        for max_x, max_y, _, _ in r(x, y, x_start=xi+1, y_start=yi+1):

            # s = abs(x1-x2) * abs(y1-y2)

            contains_count = 0
            for x3, y3 in zip(x, y):
                if min_x <= x3 <= max_x and min_y <= y3 <= max_y:
                    contains_count += 1
            if contains_count >= K:
                s = (max_x - min_x) * (max_y - min_y)
                ans = min(ans, s)

import sys
read = sys.stdin.readline


def read_ints():
    return list(map(int, read().split()))


def read_col(H, n_cols):
    '''
    H is number of rows
    n_cols is number of cols
    A列、B列が与えられるようなとき
    '''
    ret = [[] for _ in range(n_cols)]
    for _ in range(H):
        tmp = list(map(int, read().split()))
        for col in range(n_cols):
            ret[col].append(tmp[col])
    return ret


class cumsum2d:  # 二次元累積和クラス pypyでも使えるよ
    def __init__(self, ls: list):
        '''
        2次元のリストを受け取る
        '''
        from itertools import product
        H = len(ls)
        W = len(ls[0])
        self.ls_accum = [[0] * (W + 1)]
        for l in ls:
            self.ls_accum.append([0] + l)

        # 縦に累積
        for i, j in product(range(1, H + 1), range(1, W + 1)):
            self.ls_accum[i][j] += self.ls_accum[i - 1][j]
        # 横に累積
        for i, j in product(range(1, H + 1), range(1, W + 1)):
            self.ls_accum[i][j] += self.ls_accum[i][j - 1]

    def total(self, i1, j1, i2, j2):
        '''
        点(i1,j1),(i1,j2),(i2,j1),(i2,j2)の4点が成す四角の中の合計を取り出す
        ただし i1<=i2, j1<=j2
        ただし、i軸に関しては[i1,i2),j軸に関しては[j1,j2)の半開区間である
        '''
        return self.ls_accum[i2][j2] - self.ls_accum[i1][j2] \
            - self.ls_accum[i2][j1] + self.ls_accum[i1][j1]


class ZaAtu:
    def __init__(self, ls):
        # 座標圧縮クラス(仮) #どうしたら使いやすくなるのか知らんけど
        self.i_to_orig = sorted(set(ls))
        self.orig_to_i = {}
        for i, zahyou in enumerate(self.i_to_orig):
            self.orig_to_i[zahyou] = i
        self.len = len(self.i_to_orig)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.i_to_orig)
